work-units-01-workflow-008.label: remaining-work
work-units-01-workflow-008.rationale: This is the first accepted completion-feature implementation, not a repair of earlier submitted completion behavior. The original request asks for review completion to highlight the patch chat, ask yes/no, hide it on yes and reopen on typing. Baseline workspace handling clears loading before review and appends the review summary without the question; the terminal path sends ordinary chat messages and offers no completion-answer interception. The full group introduces the question and review-wait/ready handoff, private per-agent hiding plus terminal/harness close-and-reopen handling, and dependent controller, harness and terminal unit coverage. Existing ready/bell and manual-hide primitives are reused rather than counted as new unrelated work. Its following feature_done filter passes only the terminal unit test: the completion harness test is not exercised. The later C79 failure at that harness test's initial bell assertion is retained as a verification/adequacy limitation, not retroactively a purpose of this initial group. No independent repair component appears in the accepted body.

work-units-01-workflow-008.label: review-repair
work-units-01-workflow-008.rationale: The delivered reviewer finding identifies a specific defect in the already accepted completion group: it places the patch agent in WaitingForReply while review runs, but WorkerEvent::ReviewError clears only the reviewer, leaving the patch agent busy and rejecting follow-up messages. The delivered post-patch bundle confirms the exact asymmetric handler. This group adds the missing reviewed-agent loading clear and a focused regression with a fake reviewer-launch error, checking idle state and an unblocked follow-up. It neither introduces a separate requested feature nor changes the successful review/close/reopen design. An earlier attempt failed hunk matching in tests/workspace.rs after concurrent slash-test insertion; the accepted resubmission remains a real repair rather than an accepted replay. The exact regression subsequently passes and the agent returns done. This repair's purpose is distinct from the later, separately observed completion harness bell failure, which this edit does not change.

This addresses the captured API defect with no new independent requested feature. It does not change the completion-test bell setup or repair C79's earlier failing assertion; the mere existence of that validation failure does not make this a mixed validation repair. The agent then returns done; the subsequent reviewer reply is NO_FINDINGS.
